notes: These are story candidates and example predicates. A condition is descriptive, not executable; implement/validate thresholds against Songsta's real Replay period stats before use.
All source copy has independently authored German and English variants with identical named placeholders.
Select per actual underlying calendar period (YYYY-MM, YYYY, or all-time window), not per screen opening. Preserve a per-category rolling memory of last 2-3 chosen variant IDs across months.
Prioritize specific truthful variants over generic ones; if candidates repeat, use generic alternatives rather than a false statistic.
Never infer user moods, personality, or events from listening; avoid judgment and manufactured surprise.
Do not show genre-specific claims if known/credible classification coverage is too low. Likewise, do not call a song newly discovered when the available history is incomplete.
For all-time/year windows, prefer independently written period intros rather than hard-coded 'month'.
Recompute only when the period changes or measured facts materially change; use a deterministic seed and persist selection for the period.
Create complete translated sentences; avoid joining grammatical fragments inside components. Handle plurals in the localization engine.
